title: url bbcode is not stripped from file logging
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in v4.6.beta3

### System information

Godot v4.6.beta3 - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - AMD Radeon RX 6900 XT (Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.; 32.0.21037.1004) - 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-13600KF (20 threads) - 31.85 GiB memory

### Issue description

With the addition of https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/108473 we can add url bbcode to `print_rich` which allows it to be clickable to the source file, however unlike other bbcode such as colors, when logged to the file, these urls remain.

It could be argued that some people may want the url retained in the logging, I'm not sure the best way to handle this if that is desired, however my initial expectation was that it would be stripped like other bbcode.

I could always add the file path manually very easily if I want the full path included in file logs, but doing the opposite to not include, I don't think can be easily done to strip this from the file logging.

Happy to be advised if I've missed a way to achieve this.

### Steps to reproduce

```gdscript
print_rich("[color=gray]test[/color]")
print_rich("[url=res://application/application.gd:10]test[/url]")
print_rich("[color=gray][url=res://application/application.gd:10]test[/url][/color]")
```

Will output the following in the `godot.log`

```
test
[url=res://application/application.gd:10]test
[url=res://application/application.gd:10]test
```

I would except the logs to be

```
test
test
test
```

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[main.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/24511327/main.zip)

* Open and click run
* Navigate to user folder and check `godot.log`
